ko.title: 연방대법원의 새 회기 시작: 워싱턴을 재편할 수 있는 이민법 이외의 주요 사건들

segments.src: The justices returned to the bench on the first Monday in October, opening a term that will run through the midterm elections and into early summer 2027.
segments.tr: 대법관들은 10월 첫째 월요일에 법정으로 복귀하여, 중간선거를 거쳐 2027년 초여름까지 이어질 회기를 시작했습니다.

segments.src: Immigration policy is drawing much of the attention.
segments.tr: 이민 정책이 많은 관심을 끌고 있습니다.

segments.src: But the docket also holds a broad set of disputes over presidential authority, election rules and the reach of federal regulation.
segments.tr: 하지만 심리 예정 사건 명부에는 대통령의 권한, 선거 규칙, 연방 규제의 범위에 대한 광범위한 분쟁들도 포함되어 있습니다.

segments.src: How the Court resolves them could change how the White House, Congress and federal agencies work with one another.
segments.tr: 대법원이 이를 어떻게 해결하느냐에 따라 백악관, 의회, 연방 기관들이 서로 협력하는 방식이 달라질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: This guide explains what is at stake in those areas, what has already been settled, and what to watch.
segments.tr: 이 가이드는 이러한 분야에서 무엇이 걸려 있는지, 무엇이 이미 해결되었는지, 그리고 무엇을 주시해야 하는지 설명합니다.

segments.src: Dockets change as cases are added, scheduled or decided, so check the Court's official calendar for current details.
segments.tr: 사건이 추가되거나 일정이 조정되거나 판결이 내려짐에 따라 심리 예정 사건 명부는 변경되므로, 최신 세부 정보는 대법원의 공식 일정을 확인하시기 바랍니다.

segments.src: ## Why this term matters
segments.tr: ## 이번 회기가 중요한 이유

segments.src: The Court's most recent term was a major one for the balance of power among the branches.
segments.tr: 대법원의 가장 최근 회기는 정부 부처 간의 권력 균형에 있어 매우 중요한 회기였습니다.

segments.src: In *Trump v.
segments.tr: *Trump v.

segments.src: Slaughter*, the justices addressed whether the President may remove officials who exercise executive power at independent agencies, a question that has shadowed Washington since the 1935 decision in *Humphrey's Executor*.
segments.tr: Slaughter* 사건에서 대법관들은 독립 기관에서 행정권을 행사하는 공직자를 대통령이 해임할 수 있는지 여부를 다루었으며, 이는 1935년 *Humphrey's Executor* 판결 이후 워싱턴을 맴돌던 질문이었습니다.

segments.src: Legal analysts widely read the term's rulings as expanding presidential control over the executive branch.
segments.tr: 법률 분석가들은 이번 회기의 판결들이 행정부에 대한 대통령의 통제권을 확장한 것으로 널리 해석했습니다.

segments.src: Many also saw them as narrowing the practical role of Congress.
segments.tr: 많은 이들은 또한 이 판결들이 의회의 실질적인 역할을 축소한 것으로 보았습니다.

segments.src: Those rulings now shape the cases that follow.
segments.tr: 이러한 판결들은 이제 뒤이어 나오는 사건들에 영향을 미치고 있습니다.

segments.src: Lower courts, agencies and lawmakers are working out what the decisions mean in practice, and several new disputes ask the justices to draw the next lines.
segments.tr: 하급 법원, 행정 기관, 입법가들은 이 판결들이 실제로 무엇을 의미하는지 파악하고 있으며, 몇몇 새로운 분쟁들은 대법관들에게 다음 경계선을 그어달라고 요구하고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Executive power: the central theme
segments.tr: ## 행정권: 핵심 주제

segments.src: Disputes over presidential authority are likely to stay at the center of the term.
segments.tr: 대통령 권한에 대한 분쟁은 이번 회기에도 계속해서 중심에 있을 것으로 보입니다.

segments.src: Three questions recur:
segments.tr: 세 가지 질문이 반복됩니다:

segments.src: - **Who controls federal agencies?** After last term's removal-power ruling, the open questions are narrower and more technical. Which agencies, if any, remain insulated from direct presidential control? What does the ruling mean for bodies that set monetary policy or adjudicate disputes?
segments.tr: - **누가 연방 기관을 통제하는가?** 지난 회기의 해임권 판결 이후, 미결 질문들은 더 좁아지고 기술적으로 변했습니다. 대통령의 직접적인 통제로부터 격리되어 남아있는 기관이 있다면 어디일까요? 통화 정책을 수립하거나 분쟁을 조정하는 기구들에게 이 판결은 무엇을 의미할까요?

segments.src: - **How far can emergency action go?** Many major executive-branch policies have reached the justices first through the "emergency docket," which produces fast, short orders, often without full briefing or argument. Expect more of these requests, and continued debate over how much weight such orders carry as precedent.
segments.tr: - **긴급 조치는 어디까지 갈 수 있는가?** 많은 주요 행정부 정책들은 정식 서면 변론이나 구두 변론 없이 신속하고 짧은 명령을 내리는 '긴급 심리 예정 사건 명부(emergency docket)'를 통해 대법관들에게 먼저 도달했습니다. 이러한 요청이 더 많아질 것으로 예상되며, 이러한 명령이 선례로서 얼마나 큰 무게를 갖는지에 대한 논쟁도 계속될 것입니다.

segments.src: - **What can Congress still do?** Cases about spending, tariffs and delegated authority test how much power lawmakers may hand to the executive branch, and how much they can take back.
segments.tr: - **의회는 여전히 무엇을 할 수 있는가?** 지출, 관세, 위임된 권한에 관한 사건들은 입법가들이 행정부에 얼마나 많은 권한을 넘겨줄 수 있는지, 그리고 얼마나 많이 회수할 수 있는지를 시험합니다.

segments.src: Within immigration, the Court has taken up disputes over mandatory detention without bond hearings and over removals to third countries.
segments.tr: 이민 분야에서 대법원은 보석 심리 없는 의무적 구금과 제3국으로의 추방에 관한 분쟁을 다루기로 했습니다.

segments.src: Those cases are outside the scope of this guide.
segments.tr: 이 사건들은 이 가이드의 범위를 벗어납니다.

segments.src: They will still affect how far the executive's enforcement powers extend.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 행정부의 집행 권한이 어디까지 미치는지에 영향을 미칠 것입니다.

segments.src: ## Elections: rules before and after the midterms
segments.tr: ## 선거: 중간선거 전후의 규칙

segments.src: Election law is the second major area.
segments.tr: 선거법은 두 번째 주요 분야입니다.

segments.src: The Court is not expected to decide the outcome of any race.
segments.tr: 대법원이 특정 선거의 결과를 결정할 것으로 예상되지는 않습니다.

segments.src: It is being asked to rule on the rules that govern how voting works.
segments.tr: 대법원은 투표가 진행되는 방식을 규율하는 규칙에 대해 판결을 내려달라는 요청을 받고 있습니다.

segments.src: - ***Republican National Committee v. Mi Familia Vota*** asks whether the National Voter Registration Act, or an earlier federal consent decree, limits states from requiring documentary proof of citizenship when people register to vote. The answer could clarify how much room states have to set registration requirements, and how far federal law limits them.
segments.tr: - ***Republican National Committee v. Mi Familia Vota*** 사건은 전국유권자등록법(National Voter Registration Act) 또는 이전의 연방 동의 판결(consent decree)이 주 정부가 유권자 등록 시 시민권 증명 서류를 요구하는 것을 제한하는지 여부를 묻습니다. 이 답변은 주 정부가 등록 요건을 설정할 수 있는 여지가 얼마나 되는지, 그리고 연방 법률이 이를 얼마나 제한하는지 명확히 해줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Mail-in voting.** Litigation over federal efforts to restrict mail-in voting has already reached the Court on its emergency docket this year. How the justices handle that dispute will matter for election administrators in every state.
segments.tr: - **우편 투표.** 우편 투표를 제한하려는 연방 정부의 노력에 대한 소송은 올해 이미 대법원의 긴급 심리 예정 사건 명부에 도달했습니다. 대법관들이 이 분쟁을 어떻게 처리하느냐는 모든 주의 선거 관리자들에게 중요할 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Voter ID and related state laws.** Observers expect further challenges to reach the Court this fall, and some may be filed close to Election Day.
segments.tr: - **유권자 신분증 및 관련 주 법률.** 관측통들은 이번 가을에 추가적인 이의 제기가 대법원에 도달할 것으로 예상하며, 일부는 선거일에 임박하여 제기될 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: Because the term overlaps with the midterms, election officials and campaigns are watching closely.
segments.tr: 이번 회기가 중간선거와 겹치기 때문에 선거 관리들과 캠페인 관계자들은 긴밀히 주시하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Emergency applications can arrive quickly and be resolved within days.
segments.tr: 긴급 신청은 신속하게 접수되어 며칠 내에 해결될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A ruling's timing can matter as much as its substance.
segments.tr: 판결의 타이밍은 그 실질적인 내용만큼이나 중요할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Regulation and the reach of federal agencies
segments.tr: ## 규제와 연방 기관의 범위

segments.src: The third area is regulation.
segments.tr: 세 번째 분야는 규제입니다.

segments.src: The Court has been reexamining how much authority agencies have to interpret laws, adjudicate disputes and set binding rules.
segments.tr: 대법원은 기관들이 법률을 해석하고, 분쟁을 조정하며, 구속력 있는 규칙을 제정할 수 있는 권한이 얼마나 되는지 재검토해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Several questions are in play:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 질문이 작용하고 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Agency adjudication.** Companies and individuals keep challenging in-house proceedings, arguing that they raise constitutional problems about jury trials and separation of powers.
segments.tr: - **기관의 자체 조정.** 기업과 개인들은 자체 행정 절차가 배심원 재판 및 권력 분립에 관한 헌법적 문제를 제기한다고 주장하며 이에 계속해서 이의를 제기하고 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Climate and energy litigation.** *Suncor Energy v. Boulder County*, argued on the first day of the term, asks whether state-law climate claims against energy companies can move forward. The outcome could shape the future of dozens of similar lawsuits around the country.
segments.tr: - **기후 및 에너지 소송.** 회기 첫날에 변론이 진행된 *Suncor Energy v. Boulder County* 사건은 에너지 기업을 상대로 한 주법상의 기후 소송이 진행될 수 있는지 여부를 묻습니다. 그 결과는 전국적으로 제기된 수십 건의 유사한 소송의 미래를 결정할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Statutory authority.** Big cases are likely to keep turning on whether Congress clearly authorized an agency to act on matters of major economic or political significance.
segments.tr: - **법적 권한.** 주요 사건들은 의회가 경제적 또는 정치적으로 중대한 사안에 대해 기관이 조치를 취할 수 있도록 명확히 권한을 부여했는지 여부에 계속해서 좌우될 가능성이 높습니다.

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## 주시해야 할 점

segments.src: 1. **Timing.** Argued cases are usually decided by late June or early July, but some are resolved earlier. Emergency orders can come at any time.
segments.tr: 1. **타이밍.** 구두 변론을 거친 사건들은 보통 6월 말이나 7월 초까지 판결이 내려지지만, 일부는 더 일찍 해결되기도 합니다. 긴급 명령은 언제든지 나올 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Vote patterns.** The Court's conservative majority has not always split along predictable lines. Narrow, technical opinions can matter as much as sweeping ones.
segments.tr: 2. **투표 양상.** 대법원의 보수파 다수가 항상 예측 가능한 노선으로 갈라지는 것은 아닙니다. 좁고 기술적인 의견이 광범위한 의견만큼이나 중요할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Practical effects.** A ruling on paper may do little unless agencies, states and lower courts change their behavior. Follow-up litigation often defines a decision's real impact.
segments.tr: 3. **실질적인 효과.** 기관, 주, 하급 법원이 행동을 바꾸지 않는 한 문서상의 판결은 실질적인 효과가 거의 없을 수 있습니다. 후속 소송이 판결의 실제 영향력을 정의하는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Recusals and vacancies.** Individual recusals, as in the climate case, and any change to the Court's membership can alter outcomes in close cases.
segments.tr: 4. **기피 및 공석.** 기후 사건에서와 같은 개별 대법관의 기피나 대법관 구성의 변화는 팽팽한 사건에서 결과를 바꿀 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 요약

segments.src: This term is unlikely to be defined by one blockbuster.
segments.tr: 이번 회기가 단 하나의 초대형 사건으로 정의될 가능성은 낮습니다.

segments.src: It is more likely to be defined by a series of rulings that together settle how power is divided among the presidency, Congress, the states and the federal agencies.
segments.tr: 그보다는 대통령직, 의회, 주 정부, 연방 기관 간에 권력이 어떻게 분배되는지를 함께 결정하는 일련의 판결들로 정의될 가능성이 더 높습니다.

segments.src: Whatever the outcomes, the decisions will shape how Washington works for years.
segments.tr: 결과가 어떻든, 이 판결들은 향후 수년간 워싱턴이 작동하는 방식을 결정할 것입니다.

segments.src: They will also affect everyday matters such as who can register to vote, what regulators can require of businesses, and how quickly disputes are resolved.
segments.tr: 또한 누가 유권자로 등록할 수 있는지, 규제 당국이 기업에 무엇을 요구할 수 있는지, 분쟁이 얼마나 빨리 해결되는지 등 일상적인 문제에도 영향을 미칠 것입니다.

segments.tr: *이 기사는 정보 제공 목적의 일반적인 개요이며 법률 자문을 구성하지 않습니다.

segments.src: Case details and schedules may change; consult the Supreme Court's official website for current information.*
segments.tr: 사건 세부 정보 및 일정은 변경될 수 있으므로 최신 정보는 대법원 공식 웹사이트를 참조하십시오.*

Which agencies, if any, remain insulated from direct presidential control? What does the ruling mean for bodies that set monetary policy or adjudicate disputes?
segments.tr: - **谁控制联邦机构？** 在上个任期关于罢免权的裁决之后，悬而未决的问题变得更窄、更具技术性。哪些机构（如果有的话）仍能免受总统的直接控制？该裁决对于制定货币政策或裁决争议的机构意味着什么？

segments.src: - **How far can emergency action go?** Many major executive-branch policies have reached the justices first through the "emergency docket," which produces fast, short orders, often without full briefing or argument. Expect more of these requests, and continued debate over how much weight such orders carry as precedent.
segments.tr: - **紧急行动能走多远？** 许多重大的行政分支政策首先通过“紧急案卷”呈递给大法官，该案卷会产生快速、简短的命令，通常没有充分的案情陈述或辩论。预计这类申请会更多，并且关于此类命令作为先例具有多大分量的辩论仍将继续。

segments.src: - **What can Congress still do?** Cases about spending, tariffs and delegated authority test how much power lawmakers may hand to the executive branch, and how much they can take back.
segments.tr: - **国会还能做什么？** 涉及支出、关税和授权的案件考验着立法者可以向行政分支移交多少权力，以及他们可以收回多少权力。

segments.src: Within immigration, the Court has taken up disputes over mandatory detention without bond hearings and over removals to third countries.
segments.tr: 在移民领域，最高法院受理了关于无保释听证会的强制拘留以及驱逐到第三国的争议。

segments.src: Those cases are outside the scope of this guide.
segments.tr: 这些案件超出了本指南的范围。

segments.src: They will still affect how far the executive's enforcement powers extend.
segments.tr: 但它们仍将影响行政部门的执法权力延伸到何种程度。

segments.src: ## Elections: rules before and after the midterms
segments.tr: ## 选举：中期选举前后的规则

segments.src: Election law is the second major area.
segments.tr: 选举法是第二个主要领域。

segments.src: The Court is not expected to decide the outcome of any race.
segments.tr: 预计最高法院不会决定任何竞选的结果。

segments.src: It is being asked to rule on the rules that govern how voting works.
segments.tr: 它被要求对管理投票运作方式的规则做出裁决。

segments.src: - ***Republican National Committee v. Mi Familia Vota*** asks whether the National Voter Registration Act, or an earlier federal consent decree, limits states from requiring documentary proof of citizenship when people register to vote. The answer could clarify how much room states have to set registration requirements, and how far federal law limits them.
segments.tr: - ***Republican National Committee v. Mi Familia Vota*** 案探讨了《全国选民登记法》或更早的联邦同意令是否限制各州在人们登记投票时要求提供公民身份的证明文件。其答案可能会阐明各州在设定登记要求方面有多大空间，以及联邦法律在多大程度上限制了它们。

segments.src: - **Mail-in voting.** Litigation over federal efforts to restrict mail-in voting has already reached the Court on its emergency docket this year. How the justices handle that dispute will matter for election administrators in every state.
segments.tr: - **邮寄投票。** 针对限制邮寄投票的联邦举措的诉讼今年已经通过紧急案卷呈递至最高法院。大法官们如何处理该争议将对每个州的选举管理人员产生重要影响。

segments.src: - **Voter ID and related state laws.** Observers expect further challenges to reach the Court this fall, and some may be filed close to Election Day.
segments.tr: - **选民身份证及相关州法律。** 观察人士预计，今年秋天将有进一步的挑战呈递至最高法院，其中一些可能会在选举日临近时提交。

segments.src: Because the term overlaps with the midterms, election officials and campaigns are watching closely.
segments.tr: 由于该任期与中期选举重合，选举官员和竞选团队正密切关注。

segments.src: Emergency applications can arrive quickly and be resolved within days.
segments.tr: 紧急申请可能会迅速送达并在几天内得到解决。

segments.src: A ruling's timing can matter as much as its substance.
segments.tr: 裁决的时机与其实质内容同样重要。

segments.src: ## Regulation and the reach of federal agencies
segments.tr: ## 监管与联邦机构的范围

segments.src: The third area is regulation.
segments.tr: 第三个领域是监管。

segments.src: The Court has been reexamining how much authority agencies have to interpret laws, adjudicate disputes and set binding rules.
segments.tr: 最高法院一直在重新审视机构在解释法律、裁决争议和制定具有约束力的规则方面拥有多少权力。

segments.src: Several questions are in play:
segments.tr: 有几个问题正在发挥作用：

segments.src: - **Agency adjudication.** Companies and individuals keep challenging in-house proceedings, arguing that they raise constitutional problems about jury trials and separation of powers.
segments.tr: - **机构裁决。** 企业和个人不断对内部诉讼提出挑战，认为这些诉讼引发了关于陪审团审判和权力分立的宪法问题。

segments.src: - **Climate and energy litigation.** *Suncor Energy v. Boulder County*, argued on the first day of the term, asks whether state-law climate claims against energy companies can move forward. The outcome could shape the future of dozens of similar lawsuits around the country.
segments.tr: - **气候与能源诉讼。** 在本任期第一天进行辩论的 *Suncor Energy v. Boulder County* 案探讨了针对能源公司的州法气候索赔是否可以继续进行。其结果可能会塑造全国数十起类似诉讼的未来。

segments.src: - **Statutory authority.** Big cases are likely to keep turning on whether Congress clearly authorized an agency to act on matters of major economic or political significance.
segments.tr: - **法定权力。** 重大案件可能仍将取决于国会是否明确授权某一机构对具有重大经济或政治影响的事项采取行动。

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## 值得关注的动向

segments.src: 1. **Timing.** Argued cases are usually decided by late June or early July, but some are resolved earlier. Emergency orders can come at any time.
segments.tr: 1. **时机。** 辩论案件通常在 6 月底或 7 月初之前做出裁决，但有些案件会更早解决。紧急命令可能在任何时候下达。

segments.src: 2. **Vote patterns.** The Court's conservative majority has not always split along predictable lines. Narrow, technical opinions can matter as much as sweeping ones.
segments.tr: 2. **投票模式。** 最高法院的保守派多数并不总是按照可预测的界限分裂。狭隘、技术性的意见与具有广泛影响的意见同样重要。

segments.src: 3. **Practical effects.** A ruling on paper may do little unless agencies, states and lower courts change their behavior. Follow-up litigation often defines a decision's real impact.
segments.tr: 3. **实际效果。** 纸面上的裁决可能起不到什么作用，除非机构、各州和下级法院改变其行为。后续诉讼往往决定了裁决的真实影响。

segments.src: 4. **Recusals and vacancies.** Individual recusals, as in the climate case, and any change to the Court's membership can alter outcomes in close cases.
segments.tr: 4. **回避与空缺。** 个人回避（如在气候案件中）以及最高法院成员的任何变动都可能改变势均力敌案件的结果。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: This term is unlikely to be defined by one blockbuster.
segments.tr: 本任期不太可能由某一个重磅案件来定义。

segments.src: It is more likely to be defined by a series of rulings that together settle how power is divided among the presidency, Congress, the states and the federal agencies.
segments.tr: 它更有可能由一系列裁决来定义，这些裁决共同解决总统职位、国会、各州和联邦机构之间如何分配权力。

segments.src: Whatever the outcomes, the decisions will shape how Washington works for years.
segments.tr: 无论结果如何，这些决定都将重塑华盛顿未来多年的运作方式。

segments.src: They will also affect everyday matters such as who can register to vote, what regulators can require of businesses, and how quickly disputes are resolved.
segments.tr: 它们还将影响日常事务，例如谁可以登记投票、监管机构可以对企业提出什么要求，以及争议解决的速度有多快。

segments.tr: 案件详情和日程可能会发生变化；请咨询最高法院官方网站以获取最新信息。*

hi.title: सुप्रीम कोर्ट का नया सत्र शुरू हो चुका है: आव्रजन के अलावा वे बड़े मामले जो वाशिंगटन का स्वरूप बदल सकते हैं

segments.src: The justices returned to the bench on the first Monday in October, opening a term that will run through the midterm elections and into early summer 2027.
segments.tr: न्यायाधीश अक्टूबर के पहले सोमवार को पीठ पर लौटे, एक ऐसे सत्र की शुरुआत की जो मध्यावधि चुनावों से लेकर 2027 की शुरुआत तक चलेगा।

segments.src: Immigration policy is drawing much of the attention.
segments.tr: आव्रजन नीति पर काफी ध्यान आकर्षित हो रहा है।

segments.src: But the docket also holds a broad set of disputes over presidential authority, election rules and the reach of federal regulation.
segments.tr: लेकिन डॉकेट में राष्ट्रपति के अधिकार, चुनाव नियमों और संघीय विनियमन की पहुंच को लेकर विवादों का एक व्यापक समूह भी शामिल है।

segments.src: How the Court resolves them could change how the White House, Congress and federal agencies work with one another.
segments.tr: अदालत इनका समाधान कैसे करती है, यह बदल सकता है कि व्हाइट हाउस, कांग्रेस और संघीय एजेंसियां एक-दूसरे के साथ कैसे काम करती हैं।

segments.src: This guide explains what is at stake in those areas, what has already been settled, and what to watch.
segments.tr: यह मार्गदर्शिका बताती है कि उन क्षेत्रों में क्या दांव पर लगा है, क्या पहले ही तय हो चुका है, और किन बातों पर नजर रखनी है।

segments.src: Dockets change as cases are added, scheduled or decided, so check the Court's official calendar for current details.
segments.tr: जैसे-जैसे मामले जोड़े, निर्धारित या तय किए जाते हैं, डॉकेट बदलते रहते हैं, इसलिए वर्तमान विवरण के लिए अदालत के आधिकारिक कैलेंडर की जांच करें।

segments.src: ## Why this term matters
segments.tr: ## यह सत्र क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: The Court's most recent term was a major one for the balance of power among the branches.
segments.tr: अदालत का सबसे हालिया सत्र शाखाओं के बीच शक्ति संतुलन के लिए एक बड़ा सत्र था।

segments.src: In *Trump v.
segments.tr: *Trump v.

segments.src: Slaughter*, the justices addressed whether the President may remove officials who exercise executive power at independent agencies, a question that has shadowed Washington since the 1935 decision in *Humphrey's Executor*.
segments.tr: Slaughter* मामले में, न्यायाधीशों ने संबोधित किया कि क्या राष्ट्रपति उन अधिकारियों को हटा सकते हैं जो स्वतंत्र एजेंसियों में कार्यकारी शक्ति का प्रयोग करते हैं, एक ऐसा प्रश्न जिसने 1935 के *Humphrey's Executor* के फैसले के बाद से वाशिंगटन को प्रभावित किया है।

segments.src: Legal analysts widely read the term's rulings as expanding presidential control over the executive branch.
segments.tr: कानूनी विश्लेषकों ने सत्र के फैसलों को व्यापक रूप से कार्यकारी शाखा पर राष्ट्रपति के नियंत्रण का विस्तार करने के रूप में पढ़ा।

segments.src: Many also saw them as narrowing the practical role of Congress.
segments.tr: कई लोगों ने उन्हें कांग्रेस की व्यावहारिक भूमिका को सीमित करने के रूप में भी देखा।

segments.src: Those rulings now shape the cases that follow.
segments.tr: वे फैसले अब उन मामलों को आकार देते हैं जो इसके बाद आते हैं।

segments.src: Lower courts, agencies and lawmakers are working out what the decisions mean in practice, and several new disputes ask the justices to draw the next lines.
segments.tr: निचली अदालतें, एजेंसियां और कानून निर्माता यह पता लगा रहे हैं कि फैसलों का व्यवहार में क्या मतलब है, और कई नए विवाद न्यायाधीशों से अगली रेखाएं खींचने के लिए कह रहे हैं।

segments.src: ## Executive power: the central theme
segments.tr: ## कार्यकारी शक्ति: केंद्रीय विषय

segments.src: Disputes over presidential authority are likely to stay at the center of the term.
segments.tr: राष्ट्रपति के अधिकार को लेकर विवाद सत्र के केंद्र में बने रहने की संभावना है।

segments.src: Three questions recur:
segments.tr: तीन प्रश्न बार-बार आते हैं:

segments.src: - **Who controls federal agencies?** After last term's removal-power ruling, the open questions are narrower and more technical. Which agencies, if any, remain insulated from direct presidential control? What does the ruling mean for bodies that set monetary policy or adjudicate disputes?
segments.tr: - **संघीय एजेंसियों को कौन नियंत्रित करता है?** पिछले सत्र के निष्कासन-शक्ति फैसले के बाद, खुले प्रश्न संकीर्ण और अधिक तकनीकी हैं। कौन सी एजेंसियां, यदि कोई हैं, प्रत्यक्ष राष्ट्रपति नियंत्रण से सुरक्षित रहती हैं? मौद्रिक नीति निर्धारित करने या विवादों का न्यायनिर्णयन करने वाले निकायों के लिए फैसले का क्या अर्थ है?

segments.src: - **How far can emergency action go?** Many major executive-branch policies have reached the justices first through the "emergency docket," which produces fast, short orders, often without full briefing or argument. Expect more of these requests, and continued debate over how much weight such orders carry as precedent.
segments.tr: - **आपातकालीन कार्रवाई कितनी दूर तक जा सकती है?** कई प्रमुख कार्यकारी-शाखा नीतियां पहले "आपातकालीन डॉकेट" के माध्यम से न्यायाधीशों तक पहुंची हैं, जो पूर्ण ब्रीफिंग या तर्क के बिना, अक्सर तेज़, संक्षिप्त आदेश तैयार करती हैं। इन अनुरोधों के और अधिक आने की उम्मीद करें, और इस बात पर निरंतर बहस कि ऐसे आदेश मिसाल के तौर पर कितना वजन रखते हैं।

segments.src: - **What can Congress still do?** Cases about spending, tariffs and delegated authority test how much power lawmakers may hand to the executive branch, and how much they can take back.
segments.tr: - **कांग्रेस अभी भी क्या कर सकती है?** खर्च, टैरिफ और प्रत्यायोजित अधिकार के बारे में मामले परीक्षण करते हैं कि कानून निर्माता कार्यकारी शाखा को कितनी शक्ति सौंप सकते हैं, और वे कितनी वापस ले सकते हैं।

segments.src: Within immigration, the Court has taken up disputes over mandatory detention without bond hearings and over removals to third countries.
segments.tr: आव्रजन के भीतर, अदालत ने बिना बांड सुनवाई के अनिवार्य हिरासत और तीसरे देशों में निष्कासन पर विवादों को लिया है।

segments.src: Those cases are outside the scope of this guide.
segments.tr: वे मामले इस गाइड के दायरे से बाहर हैं।

segments.src: They will still affect how far the executive's enforcement powers extend.
segments.tr: वे अभी भी प्रभावित करेंगे कि कार्यकारी की प्रवर्तन शक्तियां कितनी दूर तक फैली हुई हैं।

segments.src: ## Elections: rules before and after the midterms
segments.tr: ## चुनाव: मध्यावधि से पहले और बाद के नियम

segments.src: Election law is the second major area.
segments.tr: चुनाव कानून दूसरा प्रमुख क्षेत्र है।

segments.src: The Court is not expected to decide the outcome of any race.
segments.tr: अदालत से किसी भी दौड़ के परिणाम तय करने की उम्मीद नहीं है।

segments.src: It is being asked to rule on the rules that govern how voting works.
segments.tr: इसे उन नियमों पर फैसला करने के लिए कहा जा रहा है जो नियंत्रित करते हैं कि मतदान कैसे काम करता है।

segments.src: - ***Republican National Committee v. Mi Familia Vota*** asks whether the National Voter Registration Act, or an earlier federal consent decree, limits states from requiring documentary proof of citizenship when people register to vote. The answer could clarify how much room states have to set registration requirements, and how far federal law limits them.
segments.tr: - ***Republican National Committee v. Mi Familia Vota*** पूछता है कि क्या नेशनल वोटर रजिस्ट्रेशन एक्ट, या पहले का संघीय सहमति डिक्री, राज्यों को नागरिकता के दस्तावेजी प्रमाण की आवश्यकता से सीमित करता है जब लोग मतदान के लिए पंजीकरण करते हैं। उत्तर स्पष्ट कर सकता है कि पंजीकरण आवश्यकताओं को निर्धारित करने के लिए राज्यों के पास कितनी जगह है, और संघीय कानून उन्हें कितनी दूर तक सीमित करता है।

segments.src: - **Mail-in voting.** Litigation over federal efforts to restrict mail-in voting has already reached the Court on its emergency docket this year. How the justices handle that dispute will matter for election administrators in every state.
segments.tr: - **मेल-इन वोटिंग।** मेल-इन वोटिंग को प्रतिबंधित करने के संघीय प्रयासों पर मुकदमेबाजी इस साल पहले ही अपने आपातकालीन डॉकेट पर अदालत तक पहुंच चुकी है। न्यायाधीश उस विवाद को कैसे संभालते हैं, यह हर राज्य में चुनाव प्रशासकों के लिए मायने रखेगा।

segments.src: - **Voter ID and related state laws.** Observers expect further challenges to reach the Court this fall, and some may be filed close to Election Day.
segments.tr: - **वोटर आईडी और संबंधित राज्य कानून।** पर्यवेक्षकों को उम्मीद है कि इस गिरावट में और चुनौतियां अदालत तक पहुंचेंगी, और कुछ चुनाव दिवस के करीब दायर की जा सकती हैं।

segments.src: Because the term overlaps with the midterms, election officials and campaigns are watching closely.

segments.src: Emergency applications can arrive quickly and be resolved within days.
segments.tr: आपातकालीन आवेदन जल्दी आ सकते हैं और दिनों के भीतर हल किए जा सकते हैं।

segments.src: A ruling's timing can matter as much as its substance.
segments.tr: फैसले का समय उसके सार जितना ही मायने रख सकता है।

segments.src: ## Regulation and the reach of federal agencies
segments.tr: ## विनियमन और संघीय एजेंसियों की पहुंच

segments.src: The third area is regulation.
segments.tr: तीसरा क्षेत्र विनियमन है।

segments.src: The Court has been reexamining how much authority agencies have to interpret laws, adjudicate disputes and set binding rules.
segments.tr: अदालत फिर से जांच कर रही है कि एजेंसियों के पास कानूनों की व्याख्या करने, विवादों का न्यायनिर्णयन करने और बाध्यकारी नियम निर्धारित करने का कितना अधिकार है।

segments.src: Several questions are in play:
segments.tr: कई प्रश्न खेल में हैं:

segments.src: - **Agency adjudication.** Companies and individuals keep challenging in-house proceedings, arguing that they raise constitutional problems about jury trials and separation of powers.
segments.tr: - **एजेंसी न्यायनिर्णयन।** कंपनियां और व्यक्ति इन-हाउस कार्यवाही को चुनौती देते रहते हैं, यह तर्क देते हुए कि वे जूरी परीक्षणों और शक्तियों के पृथक्करण के बारे में संवैधानिक समस्याएं पैदा करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Climate and energy litigation.** *Suncor Energy v. Boulder County*, argued on the first day of the term, asks whether state-law climate claims against energy companies can move forward. The outcome could shape the future of dozens of similar lawsuits around the country.
segments.tr: - **जलवायु और ऊर्जा मुकदमेबाजी।** *Suncor Energy v. Boulder County*, जिस पर सत्र के पहले दिन बहस हुई, पूछता है कि क्या ऊर्जा कंपनियों के खिलाफ राज्य-कानून जलवायु दावे आगे बढ़ सकते हैं। परिणाम देश भर में दर्जनों समान मुकदमों के भविष्य को आकार दे सकता है।

segments.src: - **Statutory authority.** Big cases are likely to keep turning on whether Congress clearly authorized an agency to act on matters of major economic or political significance.
segments.tr: - **सांविधिक अधिकार।** बड़े मामले इस बात पर निर्भर रहने की संभावना है कि क्या कांग्रेस ने स्पष्ट रूप से किसी एजेंसी को बड़े आर्थिक या राजनीतिक महत्व के मामलों पर कार्य करने के लिए अधिकृत किया है।

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## क्या देखना है

segments.src: 1. **Timing.** Argued cases are usually decided by late June or early July, but some are resolved earlier. Emergency orders can come at any time.
segments.tr: 1. **समय।** बहस वाले मामलों का फैसला आमतौर पर जून के अंत या जुलाई की शुरुआत तक हो जाता है, लेकिन कुछ पहले हल हो जाते हैं। आपातकालीन आदेश किसी भी समय आ सकते हैं।

segments.src: 2. **Vote patterns.** The Court's conservative majority has not always split along predictable lines. Narrow, technical opinions can matter as much as sweeping ones.
segments.tr: 2. **मतदान पैटर्न।** अदालत का रूढ़िवादी बहुमत हमेशा अनुमानित लाइनों पर विभाजित नहीं हुआ है। संकीर्ण, तकनीकी राय व्यापक राय जितनी ही मायने रख सकती है।

segments.src: 3. **Practical effects.** A ruling on paper may do little unless agencies, states and lower courts change their behavior. Follow-up litigation often defines a decision's real impact.
segments.tr: 3. **व्यावहारिक प्रभाव।** कागज पर एक फैसला तब तक बहुत कम कर सकता है जब तक कि एजेंसियां, राज्य और निचली अदालतें अपना व्यवहार न बदलें। अनुवर्ती मुकदमेबाजी अक्सर किसी निर्णय के वास्तविक प्रभाव को परिभाषित करती है।

segments.src: 4. **Recusals and vacancies.** Individual recusals, as in the climate case, and any change to the Court's membership can alter outcomes in close cases.
segments.tr: 4. **रिक्यूसल और रिक्तियां।** व्यक्तिगत रिक्यूसल, जैसा कि जलवायु मामले में है, और अदालत की सदस्यता में कोई भी बदलाव करीबी मामलों में परिणामों को बदल सकता है।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: This term is unlikely to be defined by one blockbuster.
segments.tr: यह सत्र किसी एक ब्लॉकबस्टर द्वारा परिभाषित होने की संभावना नहीं है।

segments.src: It is more likely to be defined by a series of rulings that together settle how power is divided among the presidency, Congress, the states and the federal agencies.
segments.tr: यह फैसलों की एक श्रृंखला द्वारा परिभाषित होने की अधिक संभावना है जो एक साथ यह तय करते हैं कि राष्ट्रपति पद, कांग्रेस, राज्यों और संघीय एजेंसियों के बीच शक्ति कैसे विभाजित है।

segments.src: Whatever the outcomes, the decisions will shape how Washington works for years.

es.title: El nuevo mandato de la Corte Suprema está en marcha: los grandes casos más allá de la inmigración que podrían remodelar Washington

segments.src: The justices returned to the bench on the first Monday in October, opening a term that will run through the midterm elections and into early summer 2027.
segments.tr: Los jueces regresaron al estrado el primer lunes de octubre, dando inicio a un mandato que se extenderá durante las elecciones de mitad de período y hasta principios del verano de 2027.

segments.src: Immigration policy is drawing much of the attention.
segments.tr: La política de inmigración está atrayendo gran parte de la atención.

segments.src: But the docket also holds a broad set of disputes over presidential authority, election rules and the reach of federal regulation.
segments.tr: Pero el expediente también contiene un amplio conjunto de disputas sobre la autoridad presidencial, las reglas electorales y el alcance de la regulación federal.

segments.src: How the Court resolves them could change how the White House, Congress and federal agencies work with one another.
segments.tr: La forma en que la Corte los resuelva podría cambiar cómo la Casa Blanca, el Congreso y las agencias federales trabajan entre sí.

segments.src: This guide explains what is at stake in those areas, what has already been settled, and what to watch.
segments.tr: Esta guía explica qué está en juego en esas áreas, qué ya se ha resuelto y qué observar.

segments.src: Dockets change as cases are added, scheduled or decided, so check the Court's official calendar for current details.
segments.tr: Los expedientes cambian a medida que se añaden, programan o deciden casos, así que consulte el calendario oficial de la Corte para obtener detalles actualizados.

segments.src: ## Why this term matters
segments.tr: ## Por qué es importante este mandato

segments.src: The Court's most recent term was a major one for the balance of power among the branches.
segments.tr: El mandato más reciente de la Corte fue importante para el equilibrio de poder entre las ramas.

segments.src: In *Trump v.
segments.tr: En *Trump v.

segments.src: Slaughter*, the justices addressed whether the President may remove officials who exercise executive power at independent agencies, a question that has shadowed Washington since the 1935 decision in *Humphrey's Executor*.
segments.tr: Slaughter*, los jueces abordaron si el Presidente puede destituir a funcionarios que ejercen poder ejecutivo en agencias independientes, una cuestión que ha ensombrecido a Washington desde la decisión de 1935 en *Humphrey's Executor*.

segments.src: Legal analysts widely read the term's rulings as expanding presidential control over the executive branch.
segments.tr: Los analistas legales interpretaron ampliamente los fallos del mandato como una expansión del control presidencial sobre la rama ejecutiva.

segments.src: Many also saw them as narrowing the practical role of Congress.
segments.tr: Muchos también los vieron como una reducción del papel práctico del Congreso.

segments.src: Those rulings now shape the cases that follow.
segments.tr: Esos fallos ahora dan forma a los casos que siguen.

segments.src: Lower courts, agencies and lawmakers are working out what the decisions mean in practice, and several new disputes ask the justices to draw the next lines.
segments.tr: Los tribunales inferiores, las agencias y los legisladores están determinando qué significan las decisiones en la práctica, y varias disputas nuevas piden a los jueces que tracen las siguientes líneas.

segments.src: ## Executive power: the central theme
segments.tr: ## Poder ejecutivo: el tema central

segments.src: Disputes over presidential authority are likely to stay at the center of the term.
segments.tr: Es probable que las disputas sobre la autoridad presidencial sigan siendo el centro del mandato.

segments.src: Three questions recur:
segments.tr: Tres preguntas se repiten:

segments.src: - **Who controls federal agencies?** After last term's removal-power ruling, the open questions are narrower and more technical. Which agencies, if any, remain insulated from direct presidential control? What does the ruling mean for bodies that set monetary policy or adjudicate disputes?
segments.tr: - **¿Quién controla las agencias federales?** Después del fallo sobre el poder de destitución del mandato anterior, las preguntas abiertas son más estrechas y técnicas. ¿Qué agencias, si es que hay alguna, permanecen aisladas del control presidencial directo? ¿Qué significa el fallo para los organismos que establecen la política monetaria o adjudican disputas?

segments.src: - **How far can emergency action go?** Many major executive-branch policies have reached the justices first through the "emergency docket," which produces fast, short orders, often without full briefing or argument. Expect more of these requests, and continued debate over how much weight such orders carry as precedent.
segments.tr: - **¿Hasta dónde puede llegar la acción de emergencia?** Muchas políticas importantes de la rama ejecutiva han llegado a los jueces primero a través del "expediente de emergencia", que produce órdenes rápidas y breves, a menudo sin una sesión informativa o argumento completo. Espere más de estas solicitudes y un debate continuo sobre cuánto peso tienen tales órdenes como precedente.

segments.src: - **What can Congress still do?** Cases about spending, tariffs and delegated authority test how much power lawmakers may hand to the executive branch, and how much they can take back.
segments.tr: - **¿Qué puede hacer todavía el Congreso?** Los casos sobre gastos, aranceles y autoridad delegada ponen a prueba cuánto poder pueden entregar los legisladores a la rama ejecutiva y cuánto pueden recuperar.

segments.src: Within immigration, the Court has taken up disputes over mandatory detention without bond hearings and over removals to third countries.
segments.tr: Dentro de la inmigración, la Corte ha asumido disputas sobre la detención obligatoria sin audiencias de fianza y sobre las expulsiones a terceros países.

segments.src: Those cases are outside the scope of this guide.
segments.tr: Esos casos están fuera del alcance de esta guía.

segments.src: They will still affect how far the executive's enforcement powers extend.
segments.tr: Aún así afectarán hasta dónde se extienden los poderes de aplicación de la ley del ejecutivo.

segments.src: ## Elections: rules before and after the midterms
segments.tr: ## Elecciones: reglas antes y después de las elecciones de mitad de período

segments.src: Election law is the second major area.
segments.tr: La ley electoral es la segunda área principal.

segments.src: The Court is not expected to decide the outcome of any race.
segments.tr: No se espera que la Corte decida el resultado de ninguna contienda.

segments.src: It is being asked to rule on the rules that govern how voting works.
segments.tr: Se le está pidiendo que se pronuncie sobre las reglas que rigen cómo funciona la votación.

segments.src: - ***Republican National Committee v. Mi Familia Vota*** asks whether the National Voter Registration Act, or an earlier federal consent decree, limits states from requiring documentary proof of citizenship when people register to vote. The answer could clarify how much room states have to set registration requirements, and how far federal law limits them.
segments.tr: - ***Republican National Committee v. Mi Familia Vota*** pregunta si la Ley Nacional de Registro de Votantes, o un decreto de consentimiento federal anterior, limita a los estados a exigir prueba documental de ciudadanía cuando las personas se registran para votar. La respuesta podría aclarar cuánto margen tienen los estados para establecer requisitos de registro y hasta dónde los limita la ley federal.

segments.src: - **Mail-in voting.** Litigation over federal efforts to restrict mail-in voting has already reached the Court on its emergency docket this year. How the justices handle that dispute will matter for election administrators in every state.
segments.tr: - **Votación por correo.** El litigio sobre los esfuerzos federales para restringir la votación por correo ya ha llegado a la Corte en su expediente de emergencia este año. Cómo manejen los jueces esa disputa será importante para los administradores electorales en cada estado.

segments.src: - **Voter ID and related state laws.** Observers expect further challenges to reach the Court this fall, and some may be filed close to Election Day.
segments.tr: - **Identificación de votantes y leyes estatales relacionadas.** Los observadores esperan que lleguen más desafíos a la Corte este otoño, y algunos pueden presentarse cerca del día de las elecciones.

segments.src: Because the term overlaps with the midterms, election officials and campaigns are watching closely.
segments.tr: Debido a que el mandato se superpone con las elecciones de mitad de período, los funcionarios electorales y las campañas están observando de cerca.

segments.tr: La tercera área es la regulación.

segments.tr: La Corte ha estado reexaminando cuánta autoridad tienen las agencias para interpretar leyes, adjudicar disputas y establecer reglas vinculantes.

segments.tr: - **Adjudicación de agencias.** Las empresas y los individuos siguen desafiando los procedimientos internos, argumentando que plantean problemas constitucionales sobre juicios con jurado y separación de poderes.

segments.src: - **Climate and energy litigation.** *Suncor Energy v. Boulder County*, argued on the first day of the term, asks whether state-law climate claims against energy companies can move forward. The outcome could shape the future of dozens of similar lawsuits around the country.
segments.tr: - **Litigios sobre clima y energía.** *Suncor Energy v. Boulder County*, argumentado el primer día del mandato, pregunta si las demandas climáticas basadas en leyes estatales contra empresas de energía pueden avanzar. El resultado podría dar forma al futuro de docenas de demandas similares en todo el país.

segments.src: - **Statutory authority.** Big cases are likely to keep turning on whether Congress clearly authorized an agency to act on matters of major economic or political significance.
segments.tr: - **Autoridad estatutaria.** Es probable que los grandes casos sigan dependiendo de si el Congreso autorizó claramente a una agencia a actuar en asuntos de gran importancia económica o política.

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## Qué observar

segments.src: 1. **Timing.** Argued cases are usually decided by late June or early July, but some are resolved earlier. Emergency orders can come at any time.
segments.tr: 1. **Cronología.** Los casos argumentados generalmente se deciden a fines de junio o principios de julio, pero algunos se resuelven antes. Las órdenes de emergencia pueden llegar en cualquier momento.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## La conclusión

segments.src: This term is unlikely to be defined by one blockbuster.

segments.src: It is being asked to rule on the rules that govern how voting works.

segments.src: - **Mail-in voting.** Litigation over federal efforts to restrict mail-in voting has already reached the Court on its emergency docket this year. How the justices handle that dispute will matter for election administrators in every state.
segments.tr: - **التصويت عبر البريد.** لقد وصلت التقاضي بشأن الجهود الفيدرالية لتقييد التصويت عبر البريد بالفعل إلى المحكمة في جدول أعمالها الطارئ هذا العام. وسيكون لكيفية تعامل القضاة مع هذا النزاع أهمية بالنسبة لمديري الانتخابات في كل ولاية.

segments.src: - **Voter ID and related state laws.** Observers expect further challenges to reach the Court this fall, and some may be filed close to Election Day.
segments.tr: - **هوية الناخب وقوانين الولايات ذات الصلة.** يتوقع المراقبون وصول المزيد من الطعون إلى المحكمة هذا الخريف، وقد يتم تقديم بعضها بالقرب من يوم الانتخابات.

segments.src: Because the term overlaps with the midterms, election officials and campaigns are watching closely.

segments.src: ## Regulation and the reach of federal agencies

segments.src: The third area is regulation.

segments.src: Several questions are in play:
segments.tr: وهناك عدة أسئلة مطروحة:

segments.tr: - **الفصل القضائي داخل الوكالات.** تواصل الشركات والأفراد الطعن في الإجراءات الداخلية للوكالات، بدعوى أنها تثير مشكلات دستورية تتعلق بالمحاكمات أمام هيئة محلفين وفصل السلطات.

segments.src: - **Climate and energy litigation.** *Suncor Energy v. Boulder County*, argued on the first day of the term, asks whether state-law climate claims against energy companies can move forward. The outcome could shape the future of dozens of similar lawsuits around the country.
segments.tr: - **التقاضي بشأن المناخ والطاقة.** تسأل قضية *Suncor Energy v. Boulder County*، التي جرت المرافعة فيها في اليوم الأول من الدورة، عما إذا كان يمكن المضي قدمًا في دعاوى المناخ بموجب قانون الولاية ضد شركات الطاقة. وقد يشكل الحكم مستقبل العشرات من الدعاوى القضائية المماثلة في جميع أنحاء البلاد.

segments.src: - **Statutory authority.** Big cases are likely to keep turning on whether Congress clearly authorized an agency to act on matters of major economic or political significance.
segments.tr: - **السلطة القانونية.** من المرجح أن تستمر القضايا الكبرى في الاعتماد على ما إذا كان الكونغرس قد فوض بوضوح وكالة ما للعمل في مسائل ذات أهمية اقتصادية أو سياسية كبرى.

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## ما يجب مراقبته

segments.src: 1. **Timing.** Argued cases are usually decided by late June or early July, but some are resolved earlier. Emergency orders can come at any time.
segments.tr: 1. **التوقيت.** عادة ما يتم البت في القضايا التي جرت المرافعة فيها بحلول أواخر يونيو أو أوائل يوليو، ولكن يتم تسوية بعضها قبل ذلك. ويمكن أن تصدر الأوامر الطارئة في أي وقت.

segments.src: 2. **Vote patterns.** The Court's conservative majority has not always split along predictable lines. Narrow, technical opinions can matter as much as sweeping ones.
segments.tr: 2. **أنماط التصويت.** لم تنقسم الأغلبية المحافظة في المحكمة دائمًا على طول خطوط متوقعة. ويمكن أن تكون الآراء الضيقة والتقنية بنفس أهمية الآراء الشاملة.

segments.src: 3. **Practical effects.** A ruling on paper may do little unless agencies, states and lower courts change their behavior. Follow-up litigation often defines a decision's real impact.
segments.tr: 3. **الآثار العملية.** قد لا يكون للحكم المكتوب على الورق تأثير يذكر ما لم تغير الوكالات والولايات والمحاكم الأدنى سلوكها. وغالبًا ما تحدد دعاوى المتابعة التأثير الحقيقي للقرار.

segments.src: 4. **Recusals and vacancies.** Individual recusals, as in the climate case, and any change to the Court's membership can alter outcomes in close cases.
segments.tr: 4. **التنحي والشواغر.** يمكن أن تؤدي حالات التنحي الفردية، كما هو الحال في قضية المناخ، وأي تغيير في عضوية المحكمة إلى تغيير النتائج في القضايا المتقاربة الأصوات.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: This term is unlikely to be defined by one blockbuster.
segments.tr: من غير المرجح أن تتحدد هذه الدورة بقضية واحدة ضخمة ومثيرة.

segments.src: It is more likely to be defined by a series of rulings that together settle how power is divided among the presidency, Congress, the states and the federal agencies.
segments.tr: بل من المرجح أن تتحدد بسلسلة من الأحكام التي تحدد معًا كيفية تقسيم السلطة بين الرئاسة والكونغرس والولايات والوكالات الفيدرالية.

segments.src: Whatever the outcomes, the decisions will shape how Washington works for years.
segments.tr: ومهما كانت النتائج، فإن القرارات ستشكل طريقة عمل واشنطن لسنوات قادمة.

segments.src: They will also affect everyday matters such as who can register to vote, what regulators can require of businesses, and how quickly disputes are resolved.
segments.tr: كما ستؤثر على الأمور اليومية مثل من يمكنه التسجيل للتصويت، وما يمكن للمنظمين مطالبة الشركات به، ومدى سرعة حل النزاعات.

segments.tr: Les juges ont fait leur retour sur le banc le premier lundi d'octobre, ouvrant une session qui se prolongera au-delà des élections de mi-mandat et jusqu'au début de l'été 2027.

segments.src: Immigration policy is drawing much of the attention.

segments.tr: Mais le rôle de la Cour comporte également un large éventail de litiges portant sur l'autorité présidentielle, les règles électorales et la portée de la réglementation fédérale.

segments.tr: La manière dont la Cour les résoudra pourrait modifier la façon dont la Maison-Blanche, le Congrès et les agences fédérales collaborent.

segments.tr: - **Qui contrôle les agences fédérales ?** Après l'arrêt de la session dernière sur le pouvoir de révocation, les questions en suspens sont plus étroites et plus techniques. segments.tr: - **Jusqu'où l'action d'urgence peut-elle aller ?** De nombreuses politiques majeures de la branche exécutive ont d'abord atteint les juges par le biais du « rôle d'urgence », qui produit des ordonnances rapides et courtes, souvent sans mémoire complet ni plaidoirie. Attendez-vous à une augmentation de ces demandes, ainsi qu'à un débat continu sur le poids de ces ordonnances en tant que précédents.

segments.src: - **What can Congress still do?** Cases about spending, tariffs and delegated authority test how much power lawmakers may hand to the executive branch, and how much they can take back.
segments.tr: - **Que peut encore faire le Congrès ?** Les affaires concernant les dépenses, les tarifs douaniers et la délégation de pouvoir testent l'étendue du pouvoir que les législateurs peuvent confier à la branche exécutive, et ce qu'ils peuvent récupérer.

pt.title: O Novo Período de Sessões da Suprema Corte Está em Andamento: Os Grandes Casos Além da Imigração que Podem Redesenhar Washington

segments.src: The justices returned to the bench on the first Monday in October, opening a term that will run through the midterm elections and into early summer 2027.
segments.tr: Os ministros retornaram ao plenário na primeira segunda-feira de outubro, inaugurando um período de sessões que se estenderá pelas eleições de meio de mandato e adentra o início do verão de 2027.

segments.src: Immigration policy is drawing much of the attention.
segments.tr: A política de imigração está atraindo grande parte da atenção.

segments.src: But the docket also holds a broad set of disputes over presidential authority, election rules and the reach of federal regulation.
segments.tr: Mas a pauta também traz um conjunto amplo de disputas sobre a autoridade presidencial, regras eleitorais e o alcance da regulamentação federal.

segments.src: How the Court resolves them could change how the White House, Congress and federal agencies work with one another.
segments.tr: A forma como a Corte resolver essas questões pode mudar a maneira como a Casa Blanca, o Congresso e as agências federais trabalham entre si.

segments.src: This guide explains what is at stake in those areas, what has already been settled, and what to watch.
segments.tr: Este guia explica o que está em jogo nessas áreas, o que já foi decidido e o que acompanhar.

segments.src: Dockets change as cases are added, scheduled or decided, so check the Court's official calendar for current details.
segments.tr: As pautas mudam à medida que casos são adicionados, agendados ou julgados, portanto consulte o calendário oficial da Corte para obter detalhes atuais.

segments.src: ## Why this term matters
segments.tr: ## Por que este período importa

segments.src: The Court's most recent term was a major one for the balance of power among the branches.
segments.tr: O período de sessões mais recente da Corte foi marcante para o equilíbrio de poderes entre os poderes.

segments.src: In *Trump v.
segments.tr: Em *Trump v.

segments.src: Slaughter*, the justices addressed whether the President may remove officials who exercise executive power at independent agencies, a question that has shadowed Washington since the 1935 decision in *Humphrey's Executor*.
segments.tr: Slaughter*, os ministros abordaram se o Presidente pode destituir funcionários que exercem poder executivo em agências independentes, uma questão que paira sobre Washington desde a decisão de 1935 em *Humphrey's Executor*.

segments.src: Legal analysts widely read the term's rulings as expanding presidential control over the executive branch.
segments.tr: Analistas jurídicos interpretam amplamente as decisões do período como uma expansão do controle presidencial sobre o Poder Executivo.

segments.src: Many also saw them as narrowing the practical role of Congress.
segments.tr: Muitos também as viram como uma redução do papel prático do Congresso.

segments.src: Those rulings now shape the cases that follow.
segments.tr: Essas decisões agora moldam os casos que se seguem.

segments.src: Lower courts, agencies and lawmakers are working out what the decisions mean in practice, and several new disputes ask the justices to draw the next lines.
segments.tr: Tribunais inferiores, agências e legisladores estão definindo o que as decisões significam na prática, e várias novas disputas pedem aos ministros que tracem os próximos limites.

segments.src: ## Executive power: the central theme
segments.tr: ## Poder executivo: o tema central

segments.src: Disputes over presidential authority are likely to stay at the center of the term.
segments.tr: Disputas sobre a autoridade presidencial provavelmente permanecerão no centro do período de sessões.

segments.src: Three questions recur:
segments.tr: Três questões se repetem:

segments.src: - **Who controls federal agencies?** After last term's removal-power ruling, the open questions are narrower and more technical. Which agencies, if any, remain insulated from direct presidential control? What does the ruling mean for bodies that set monetary policy or adjudicate disputes?
segments.tr: - **Quem controla as agências federais?** Após a decisão sobre o poder de destituição do último período, as questões em aberto são mais restritas e técnicas. Quais agências, se houver alguma, permanecem isoladas do controle presidencial direto? O que a decisão significa para órgãos que definem política monetária ou julgam disputas?

segments.src: - **How far can emergency action go?** Many major executive-branch policies have reached the justices first through the "emergency docket," which produces fast, short orders, often without full briefing or argument. Expect more of these requests, and continued debate over how much weight such orders carry as precedent.
segments.tr: - **Até onde pode ir a ação de emergência?** Muitas políticas importantes do Poder Executivo chegaram aos ministros primeiro por meio da "pauta de emergência", que produz ordens rápidas e curtas, frequentemente sem peticionamento completo ou sustentação oral. Espere mais solicitações desse tipo e um debate contínuo sobre o peso que tais ordens carregam como precedente.

segments.src: - **What can Congress still do?** Cases about spending, tariffs and delegated authority test how much power lawmakers may hand to the executive branch, and how much they can take back.
segments.tr: - **O que o Congresso ainda pode fazer?** Casos sobre gastos, tarifas e autoridade delegada testam quanto poder os legisladores podem entregar ao Poder Executivo e quanto podem reaver.

segments.src: Within immigration, the Court has taken up disputes over mandatory detention without bond hearings and over removals to third countries.
segments.tr: Dentro da imigração, a Corte aceitou disputas sobre detenção obrigatória sem audiências de fiança e sobre deportações para terceiros países.

segments.src: Those cases are outside the scope of this guide.
segments.tr: Esses casos estão fora do escopo deste guia.

segments.src: They will still affect how far the executive's enforcement powers extend.
segments.tr: Eles ainda afetarão até onde se estendem os poderes de execução do Executivo.

segments.src: ## Elections: rules before and after the midterms
segments.tr: ## Eleições: regras antes e depois das eleições de meio de mandato

segments.src: Election law is the second major area.
segments.tr: O direito eleitoral é a segunda área principal.

segments.src: The Court is not expected to decide the outcome of any race.
segments.tr: Não se espera que a Corte decida o resultado de nenhuma disputa eleitoral.

segments.src: It is being asked to rule on the rules that govern how voting works.
segments.tr: Ela está sendo solicitada a se pronunciar sobre as regras que governam como a votação funciona.

segments.src: - ***Republican National Committee v. Mi Familia Vota*** asks whether the National Voter Registration Act, or an earlier federal consent decree, limits states from requiring documentary proof of citizenship when people register to vote. The answer could clarify how much room states have to set registration requirements, and how far federal law limits them.
segments.tr: - ***Republican National Committee v. Mi Familia Vota*** questiona se a Lei Nacional de Registro de Eleitores, ou um decreto de consentimento federal anterior, impede que os estados exijam prova documental de cidadania quando as pessoas se registram para votar. A resposta pode esclarecer quanta margem os estados têm para definir requisitos de registro e até que ponto a lei federal os limita.

segments.src: - **Mail-in voting.** Litigation over federal efforts to restrict mail-in voting has already reached the Court on its emergency docket this year. How the justices handle that dispute will matter for election administrators in every state.
segments.tr: - **Votação por correio.** Litígios sobre esforços federais para restringir a votação por correio já chegaram à Corte em sua pauta de emergência este ano. A forma como os ministros lidarão com essa disputa importará para os administradores eleitorais em todos os estados.

segments.src: - **Voter ID and related state laws.** Observers expect further challenges to reach the Court this fall, and some may be filed close to Election Day.
segments.tr: - **Documento de identidade de eleitor (Voter ID) e leis estaduais relacionadas.** Observadores esperam que novos recursos cheguem à Corte neste outono, e alguns podem ser protocolados perto do Dia da Eleição.

segments.src: Because the term overlaps with the midterms, election officials and campaigns are watching closely.
segments.tr: Como o período coincide com as eleições de meio de mandato, autoridades eleitorais e campanhas estão acompanhando de perto.

segments.src: Emergency applications can arrive quickly and be resolved within days.
segments.tr: Solicitações de emergência podem chegar rapidamente e ser resolvidas em dias.

segments.src: A ruling's timing can matter as much as its substance.
segments.tr: O momento de uma decisão pode importar tanto quanto seu conteúdo.

segments.src: ## Regulation and the reach of federal agencies
segments.tr: ## Regulamentação e o alcance das agências federais

segments.src: The third area is regulation.
segments.tr: A terceira área é a regulamentação.

segments.src: The Court has been reexamining how much authority agencies have to interpret laws, adjudicate disputes and set binding rules.
segments.tr: A Corte vem reavaliando quanta autoridade as agências têm para interpretar leis, julgar disputas e estabelecer regras vinculantes.

segments.src: Several questions are in play:
segments.tr: Várias questões estão em jogo:

segments.src: - **Agency adjudication.** Companies and individuals keep challenging in-house proceedings, arguing that they raise constitutional problems about jury trials and separation of powers.
segments.tr: - **Julgamentos administrativos.** Empresas e indivíduos continuam contestando processos internos, argumentando que eles levam a problemas constitucionais sobre julgamentos por júri e separação de poderes.

segments.src: - **Climate and energy litigation.** *Suncor Energy v. Boulder County*, argued on the first day of the term, asks whether state-law climate claims against energy companies can move forward. The outcome could shape the future of dozens of similar lawsuits around the country.
segments.tr: - **Litígios sobre clima e energia.** *Suncor Energy v. Boulder County*, argumentado no primeiro dia do período de sessões, questiona se reclamações climáticas baseadas em leis estaduais contra empresas de energia podem prosseguir. O resultado pode moldar o futuro de dezenas de processos semelhantes em todo o país.

segments.src: - **Statutory authority.** Big cases are likely to keep turning on whether Congress clearly authorized an agency to act on matters of major economic or political significance.
segments.tr: - **Autoridade estatutária.** Grandes casos provavelmente continuarão girando em torno de saber se o Congresso autorizou claramente uma agência a agir em assuntos de grande importância econômica ou política.

segments.tr: ## O que acompanhar

segments.tr: 1. **Prazos.** Casos com sustentação oral geralmente são decididos no final de junho ou início de julho, mas alguns são resolvidos antes. Ordens de emergência podem vir a qualquer momento.

segments.src: 2. **Vote patterns.** The Court's conservative majority has not always split along predictable lines. Narrow, technical opinions can matter as much as sweeping ones.
segments.tr: 2. **Padrões de votação.** A maioria conservadora da Corte nem sempre se divide em linhas previsíveis. Opiniões restritas e técnicas podem importar tanto quanto as abrangentes.

segments.src: 3. **Practical effects.** A ruling on paper may do little unless agencies, states and lower courts change their behavior. Follow-up litigation often defines a decision's real impact.
segments.tr: 3. **Efeitos práticos.** Uma decisão no papel pode fazer pouco a menos que agências, estados e tribunais inferiores mudem seu comportamento. Litígios de acompanhamento frequentemente definem o impacto real de uma decisão.

segments.src: 4. **Recusals and vacancies.** Individual recusals, as in the climate case, and any change to the Court's membership can alter outcomes in close cases.
segments.tr: 4. ** Impedimentos e vagas.** Impedimentos individuais, como no caso do clima, e qualquer mudança na composição da Corte podem alterar os resultados em casos equilibrados.

segments.src: - **Climate and energy litigation.** *Suncor Energy v. Boulder County*, argued on the first day of the term, asks whether state-law climate claims against energy companies can move forward. The outcome could shape the future of dozens of similar lawsuits around the country.
segments.tr: - **Litigasi iklim dan energi.** *Suncor Energy v. Boulder County*, yang diperdebatkan pada hari pertama masa persidangan, menanyakan apakah klaim iklim berdasarkan hukum negara bagian terhadap perusahaan energi dapat dilanjutkan. Hasilnya dapat membentuk masa depan puluhan tuntutan hukum serupa di seluruh negeri.

segments.src: - **Statutory authority.** Big cases are likely to keep turning on whether Congress clearly authorized an agency to act on matters of major economic or political significance.
segments.tr: - **Otoritas hukum.** Kasus-kasus besar kemungkinan akan terus bergantung pada apakah Kongres dengan jelas memberi wewenang kepada suatu lembaga untuk bertindak dalam masalah yang memiliki signifikansi ekonomi atau politik yang besar.

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## Apa yang perlu diperhatikan

segments.src: 1. **Timing.** Argued cases are usually decided by late June or early July, but some are resolved earlier. Emergency orders can come at any time.
segments.tr: 1. **Waktu.** Kasus yang diperdebatkan biasanya diputuskan pada akhir Juni atau awal Juli, tetapi beberapa diselesaikan lebih awal. Perintah darurat bisa datang kapan saja.

segments.src: 2. **Vote patterns.** The Court's conservative majority has not always split along predictable lines. Narrow, technical opinions can matter as much as sweeping ones.
segments.tr: 2. **Pola pemungutan suara.** Mayoritas konservatif Mahkamah tidak selalu terpecah menurut garis yang dapat diprediksi. Pendapat yang sempit dan teknis bisa sama pentingnya dengan pendapat yang luas.

segments.src: 3. **Practical effects.** A ruling on paper may do little unless agencies, states and lower courts change their behavior. Follow-up litigation often defines a decision's real impact.
segments.tr: 3. **Efek praktis.** Putusan di atas kertas mungkin tidak banyak berarti kecuali lembaga, negara bagian, dan pengadilan yang lebih rendah mengubah perilaku mereka. Litigasi tindak lanjut sering kali menentukan dampak nyata dari suatu keputusan.

segments.src: 4. **Recusals and vacancies.** Individual recusals, as in the climate case, and any change to the Court's membership can alter outcomes in close cases.
segments.tr: 4. **Pengunduran diri dan kekosongan.** Pengunduran diri individu, seperti dalam kasus iklim, dan perubahan apa pun pada keanggotaan Mahkamah dapat mengubah hasil dalam kasus-kasus yang ketat.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: This term is unlikely to be defined by one blockbuster.
segments.tr: Masa persidangan ini kemungkinan tidak akan ditentukan oleh satu kasus besar.

segments.src: It is more likely to be defined by a series of rulings that together settle how power is divided among the presidency, Congress, the states and the federal agencies.

segments.src: Whatever the outcomes, the decisions will shape how Washington works for years.
segments.tr: Apa pun hasilnya, keputusan tersebut akan membentuk cara kerja Washington selama bertahun-tahun.

segments.src: They will also affect everyday matters such as who can register to vote, what regulators can require of businesses, and how quickly disputes are resolved.
segments.tr: Keputusan tersebut juga akan memengaruhi masalah sehari-hari seperti siapa yang dapat mendaftar untuk memilih, apa yang dapat diminta oleh regulator dari bisnis, dan seberapa cepat perselisihan diselesaikan.

ja.title: 連邦最高裁の新会期が開幕：ワシントンの形を変えうる、移民問題以外の重要な訴訟

segments.src: The justices returned to the bench on the first Monday in October, opening a term that will run through the midterm elections and into early summer 2027.
segments.tr: 最高裁判所判事らは10月の第1月曜日にベンチに復帰し、中間選挙を経て2027年初夏まで続く会期を開始した。

segments.src: Immigration policy is drawing much of the attention.
segments.tr: 移民政策が多くの注目を集めている。

segments.src: But the docket also holds a broad set of disputes over presidential authority, election rules and the reach of federal regulation.
segments.tr: しかし、ドケット（審理事件表）には、大統領権限、選挙規則、連邦規制の範囲に関する幅広い紛争も含まれている。

segments.src: How the Court resolves them could change how the White House, Congress and federal agencies work with one another.
segments.tr: 最高裁がこれらをどのように解決するかによって、ホワイトハウス、議会、連邦機関の相互協力のあり方が変わる可能性がある。

segments.src: This guide explains what is at stake in those areas, what has already been settled, and what to watch.
segments.tr: 本ガイドでは、これらの分野における賭けられているもの、すでに解決されたこと、そして注目すべき点について解説する。

segments.tr: 事件の追加、日程変更、判決などによりドケットは変動するため、最新の詳細については最高裁の公式カレンダーを確認してほしい。

segments.src: ## Why this term matters
segments.tr: ## 今会期が重要である理由

segments.src: The Court's most recent term was a major one for the balance of power among the branches.
segments.tr: 最高裁の直近の会期は、各部門間の権力バランスにとって重要なものであった。

segments.src: In *Trump v.
segments.tr: 「*Trump v.

segments.src: Slaughter*, the justices addressed whether the President may remove officials who exercise executive power at independent agencies, a question that has shadowed Washington since the 1935 decision in *Humphrey's Executor*.
segments.tr: Slaughter*」において、判事らは、独立機関で行政権を行使する官僚を大統領が解任できるかどうかという問題に対処した。これは1935年の「*Humphrey's Executor*」判決以来、ワシントンに影を落とし続けてきた疑問である。

segments.src: Legal analysts widely read the term's rulings as expanding presidential control over the executive branch.
segments.tr: 法務アナリストらは、今会期の裁定の多くが行政機関に対する大統領の統制を拡大するものと広く読み解いている。

segments.src: Many also saw them as narrowing the practical role of Congress.
segments.tr: また、多くの人がこれらを議会の実質的な役割を狭めるものと捉えた。

segments.src: Those rulings now shape the cases that follow.
segments.tr: それらの裁定は、今後の訴訟の形を現在形作っている。

segments.src: Lower courts, agencies and lawmakers are working out what the decisions mean in practice, and several new disputes ask the justices to draw the next lines.
segments.tr: 下級審、機関、立法府は、それらの判決が実際何を意味するのかを検討しており、いくつかの新たな紛争が判事らに次の境界線を引くよう求めている。

segments.src: ## Executive power: the central theme
segments.tr: ## 行政権：中心的なテーマ

segments.src: Disputes over presidential authority are likely to stay at the center of the term.
segments.tr: 大統領権限をめぐる紛争は、今会期の中核に留まりそうである。

segments.src: Three questions recur:
segments.tr: 以下の3つの疑問が繰り返し浮上している。

segments.src: - **Who controls federal agencies?** After last term's removal-power ruling, the open questions are narrower and more technical. Which agencies, if any, remain insulated from direct presidential control? What does the ruling mean for bodies that set monetary policy or adjudicate disputes?
segments.tr: - **誰が連邦機関を統制するのか？** 先会期の解任権に関する判決を受け、未解決の疑問はより狭く、より技術的なものとなっている。どの機関が（もしあれば）大統領の直接統制から保護されたままなのか？ この判決は、金融政策を決定する機関や紛争を裁定する機関にとって何を意味するのか？

segments.src: - **How far can emergency action go?** Many major executive-branch policies have reached the justices first through the "emergency docket," which produces fast, short orders, often without full briefing or argument. Expect more of these requests, and continued debate over how much weight such orders carry as precedent.
segments.tr: - **緊急措置はどこまで許されるのか？** 主要な行政機関の政策の多くは、十分な準備書面や弁論なしに、迅速かつ短期間の命令をもたらす「緊急ドケット」を通じて最初に最高裁に到達している。こうした要請の増加と、そうした命令が判例としてどれほどの重みを持つかについての継続的な議論が予想される。

segments.src: - **What can Congress still do?** Cases about spending, tariffs and delegated authority test how much power lawmakers may hand to the executive branch, and how much they can take back.
segments.tr: - **議会にまだ何ができるのか？** 支出、関税、委任権限に関する訴訟は、立法府が行政機関にどれだけの権力を委譲できるか、そしてどれだけを取り戻せるかを試している。

segments.src: Within immigration, the Court has taken up disputes over mandatory detention without bond hearings and over removals to third countries.
segments.tr: 移民問題に関して、最高裁は保釈審問なしの強制収容や第三国への強制送還をめぐる紛争を取り上げている。

segments.src: Those cases are outside the scope of this guide.
segments.tr: これらの訴訟は本ガイドの範囲外である。

segments.src: They will still affect how far the executive's enforcement powers extend.
segments.tr: それでもこれらは、行政の執行権がどこまで及ぶかに影響を与えるだろう。

segments.src: ## Elections: rules before and after the midterms
segments.tr: ## 選挙：中間選挙の前後の規則

segments.src: Election law is the second major area.
segments.tr: 選挙法は2つ目の主要な分野である。

segments.src: The Court is not expected to decide the outcome of any race.
segments.tr: 最高裁はいずれかのレースの結果を決定することは予想されていない。

segments.src: It is being asked to rule on the rules that govern how voting works.
segments.tr: 投票の仕組みを規律する規則について裁定を下すよう求められているのだ。

segments.src: - ***Republican National Committee v. Mi Familia Vota*** asks whether the National Voter Registration Act, or an earlier federal consent decree, limits states from requiring documentary proof of citizenship when people register to vote. The answer could clarify how much room states have to set registration requirements, and how far federal law limits them.
segments.tr: - ***Republican National Committee v. Mi Familia Vota*」は、国家有権者登録法、または以前の連邦同意判決が、有権者登録時に州が市民権の文書による証明を要求することを制限しているかどうかを問うている。その答えは、州が登録要件を設定する余地がどれだけあるか、そして連邦法がそれらをどの程度制限しているかを明確にする可能性がある。

segments.src: - **Mail-in voting.** Litigation over federal efforts to restrict mail-in voting has already reached the Court on its emergency docket this year. How the justices handle that dispute will matter for election administrators in every state.
segments.tr: - **郵送投票。** 郵送投票を制限する連邦の取り組みをめぐる訴訟は、今年すでに緊急ドケットで最高裁に到達している。判事らがその紛争をどのように処理するかは、すべての州の選挙管理担当者にとって重要となる。

segments.src: - **Voter ID and related state laws.** Observers expect further challenges to reach the Court this fall, and some may be filed close to Election Day.
segments.tr: - **有権者IDおよび関連する州法。** 観察筋は、今秋にさらなる異議申し立てが最高裁に届くと予想しており、中には選挙日の直前に提出されるものもあるかもしれない。

segments.src: Because the term overlaps with the midterms, election officials and campaigns are watching closely.
segments.tr: 今会期は中間選挙と重なっているため、選挙管理官や選挙陣営は注視している。

segments.src: Emergency applications can arrive quickly and be resolved within days.
segments.tr: 緊急の申し立ては迅速に到着し、数日以内に解決される可能性がある。

segments.src: A ruling's timing can matter as much as its substance.
segments.tr: 裁定のタイミングは、その内容と同じくらい重要である。

segments.src: ## Regulation and the reach of federal agencies
segments.tr: ## 規制と連邦機関の範囲

segments.src: The third area is regulation.
segments.tr: 第3の分野は規制である。

segments.src: The Court has been reexamining how much authority agencies have to interpret laws, adjudicate disputes and set binding rules.
segments.tr: 最高裁は、機関が法律を解釈し、紛争を裁定し、拘束力のある規則を制定する権限をどれだけ持っているかを再検証している。

segments.src: Several questions are in play:
segments.tr: いくつかの疑問が浮上している。

segments.src: - **Agency adjudication.** Companies and individuals keep challenging in-house proceedings, arguing that they raise constitutional problems about jury trials and separation of powers.
segments.tr: - **機関による裁定。** 企業や個人は、陪審裁判や権力分立に関する憲法上の問題提起を引き起こしているとして、組織内の手続きへの異議申し立てを続けている。

segments.src: - **Climate and energy litigation.** *Suncor Energy v. Boulder County*, argued on the first day of the term, asks whether state-law climate claims against energy companies can move forward. The outcome could shape the future of dozens of similar lawsuits around the country.
segments.tr: - **気候変動およびエネルギー訴訟。** 会期の初日に弁論が行われた「*Suncor Energy v. Boulder County*」は、エネルギー企業に対する州法に基づく気候変動に関する主張を進めることができるかどうかを問うている。その結果は、全国での同様の数十件の訴訟の将来を形作る可能性がある。

segments.src: - **Statutory authority.** Big cases are likely to keep turning on whether Congress clearly authorized an agency to act on matters of major economic or political significance.
segments.tr: - **法定権限。** 重大な経済的または政治的重要性を持つ事項について、議会が機関に行動する権限を明確に与えたかどうかに、重要な訴訟は引き続き依存する可能性が高い。

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## 注目すべき点

segments.src: 1. **Timing.** Argued cases are usually decided by late June or early July, but some are resolved earlier. Emergency orders can come at any time.
segments.tr: 1. **タイミング。** 弁論が行われた訴訟は通常、6月下旬または7月上旬までに判決が出るが、一部はより早く解決される。緊急命令はいつでも出る可能性がある。

segments.src: 2. **Vote patterns.** The Court's conservative majority has not always split along predictable lines. Narrow, technical opinions can matter as much as sweeping ones.
segments.tr: 2. **投票の傾向。** 最高裁の保守派の過半数は、常に予測可能な線に沿って分裂しているわけではない。狭く技術的な意見は、広範囲に及ぶ意見と同じくらい重要である場合がある。

segments.src: 3. **Practical effects.** A ruling on paper may do little unless agencies, states and lower courts change their behavior. Follow-up litigation often defines a decision's real impact.
segments.tr: 3. **実践的な影響。** 機関、州、下級審が行動を変えない限り、紙上の裁定は何の役にも立たないかもしれない。その後の訴訟が、判決の真の影響を定義することが多い。

segments.src: 4. **Recusals and vacancies.** Individual recusals, as in the climate case, and any change to the Court's membership can alter outcomes in close cases.
segments.tr: 4. **忌避と欠員。** 気候変動訴訟におけるような個人の忌避、および最高裁の構成員の変更は、伯仲した事件の結果を変える可能性がある。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: This term is unlikely to be defined by one blockbuster.
segments.tr: 今会期が1つの大ヒット作によって定義される可能性は低い。

segments.src: It is more likely to be defined by a series of rulings that together settle how power is divided among the presidency, Congress, the states and the federal agencies.

segments.src: Whatever the outcomes, the decisions will shape how Washington works for years.

segments.src: They will also affect everyday matters such as who can register to vote, what regulators can require of businesses, and how quickly disputes are resolved.
